nodes.summary: There is a strictly increasing sequence $a_0 < a_1 < a_2 < \cdots$ of positive integers such that the number $f(n)$ of pairs $(u, v)$ of natural numbers with $u \le v$ and $a_u + a_{u+1} + \cdots + a_v = n$ tends to infinity as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Interval sums with unbounded representation counts (Erdős Problem 358)

nodes.summary: This is the proposition that there is a strictly increasing sequence $a_0 < a_1 < a_2 < \cdots$ of positive integers whose interval-sum representation count $f(n)$, the number of pairs $(u, v)$ of natural numbers with $u \le v$ and $a_u + a_{u+1} + \cdots + a_v = n$, tends to infinity as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: The interval-sum conjecture of Erdős Problem 358

nodes.summary: For a sequence $a_0, a_1, a_2, \ldots$ of natural numbers and a natural number $n$, $f_a(n)$ is the number of pairs $(u, v)$ of natural numbers with $u \le v$ and $a_u + a_{u+1} + \cdots + a_v = n$, and $f_a(n) = 0$ if there are infinitely many such pairs.
nodes.title: Interval-sum representation count
